meta.source: 7 decks (CAiSE'25, CAiSE'26, ICWE'25, JCIS'25, ICSOC'24 SOC4AI, SCORE PhD Forum 2025/2026) — PowerPoint theme 'isa-v2', colour scheme 'Colores Cristina'
meta.units: Lengths are px on a 1920×1080 slide canvas (144 px per inch; 1 pt = 2 px). Divide by 2 to get PowerPoint points.

tokens.name: crimson
tokens.usage: Theme accent1/accent2/dk2. Slide titles, statement text, accent words, outline cards. 7.6:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: crimson-deep
tokens.usage: Title-slide band fill, logical slide number, arrows, filled bars, RQ pills, spotlight frame (FJCL decks). 11:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: crimson-ink
tokens.usage: Dark crimson diagram ink: braces, connector fans, thick 6 pt outlines.

tokens.name: crimson-night
tokens.usage: Text on `card-rose` fills.

tokens.name: signal-red
tokens.usage: Agenda arc, agenda circles and item frames, quote-card frame. 5.9:1 on `surface`.

tokens.name: alert-red
tokens.usage: Spotlight frames in the AGF decks (3 pt) and struck-through words. Marks only — 4.0:1 on `surface`, below the 4.5:1 text floor.

tokens.name: on-crimson
tokens.usage: Text on `crimson`, `crimson-deep` and `signal-red` fills (title band, RQ pills, filled agenda circle).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Every slide background (theme lt1). The style never uses dark slides.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Theme dk1. Body text, author names, agenda labels on `surface`.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Citations footer, small captions on `surface`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Master body-placeholder grey (bg1 at 50 %) and the venue/date lines on the title slide; also the focus-overlay veil colour. 4.0:1 on `surface` — only for text 24 px+ (source value kept).

tokens.name: veil
tokens.usage: Full-slide focus overlay that pushes a diagram back while a quote card or detail is shown on top.

tokens.name: card-blue
tokens.usage: Layer card fill (draw.io blue) — 'Accessibility layer'. Text `card-blue-ink`.

tokens.name: card-blue-line
tokens.usage: 1.5 pt border of `card-blue` cards.

tokens.name: card-blue-ink
tokens.usage: Caps label inside `card-blue` cards (4.3:1 — keep it 36 px+).

tokens.name: card-green
tokens.usage: Layer card fill (draw.io green) — 'Orchestration layer'.

tokens.name: card-green-line
tokens.usage: 1.5 pt border of `card-green` cards.

tokens.name: card-green-ink
tokens.usage: Caps label inside `card-green` cards. Source pair is only 2.1:1 — use `ink` instead when legibility matters.

tokens.name: card-orange
tokens.usage: Layer card fill (draw.io orange) — 'Capability layer'. Label in `crimson`.

tokens.name: card-orange-line
tokens.usage: 1.5 pt border of `card-orange` cards.

tokens.name: card-pink
tokens.usage: Soft crimson card fill (coverage cards, RQ answers, highlighted stat panels).

tokens.name: card-pink-line
tokens.usage: Border of `card-pink` and of white RQ cards.

tokens.name: card-rose
tokens.usage: Stronger crimson tint for emphasised panels; border `card-rose-line`.

tokens.name: card-rose-line
tokens.usage: Border of `card-rose` panels.

tokens.name: stat-fill
tokens.usage: Stat bubble fill ('30 SaaS', '162 pricings'); number in `crimson-deep`.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Stat bubble border, highlights in timelines / DevOps charts.

tokens.name: navy
tokens.usage: DevOps infinity loop — dark lobe; dark chart series.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: DevOps infinity loop — light lobe; positive series.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Ticks, 'valid' marks, positive deltas (marks only).

tokens.name: teal-deep
tokens.usage: Theme accent3 — secondary diagram colour, goal markers.

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Theme accent4 — arrows between process boxes, secondary series.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Theme accent5 — tertiary series, 'future goal' markers.

tokens.name: bronze
tokens.usage: Theme accent6 — rarely used; fourth chart series.

styles.name: slide-title
styles.usage: 28 pt bold, centred, `crimson`. Theme heading font (Arial Narrow). AGF decks set the same title in Roboto bold 32 pt.

styles.name: statement
styles.usage: 36 pt, centred on an empty slide, `crimson`; one or two words may switch to `crimson-deep`.

styles.name: band-title
styles.usage: 30 pt bold, white, centred inside the `crimson-deep` band.

styles.name: affiliation
styles.sample: SCORE Lab, I3US, Universidad de Sevilla, Seville, Spain

styles.name: body-lg
styles.usage: 28 pt — the most frequent body size in the decks; labels inside diagrams and big claims.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Input: an URL pointing to a SaaS pricing page

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Characterizes the current scope of PI support
styles.usage: 14 pt notes under labels, diagram annotations.

styles.name: agenda-item
styles.usage: 30 pt bold CAPS `ink` inside agenda frames.

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: 22 pt CAPS inside layer cards, coloured with the card's ink.

styles.name: point-number
styles.usage: 72 pt light `crimson` numerals for numbered points (future work, contributions).

styles.name: quote
styles.sample: an alternative DevOps cycle aimed at optimizing…
styles.usage: 20 pt italic, justified, in a quote card; the defined term in bold italic.

styles.name: slide-number
styles.usage: 24–28 pt `crimson-deep`, bottom-right, with identical size, position, color and text style across the deck. LOGICAL number: repeated across every slide of a morph build; 'n/N' in PhD-forum decks. During a figure/architecture zoom, the box may Morph outside the visible canvas and must return to this baseline afterwards.

styles.name: citation
styles.sample: García-Fernández, A., Parejo, J. A., & Ruiz-Cortés, A. (2024). Pricing4SaaS…
styles.usage: 9 pt `ink-soft` APA reference bottom-left; venue in italics.

tokens.name: space-edge
tokens.usage: Left/right inset of titles and content (609 600 EMU = 0.667 in).

tokens.name: space-title-top
tokens.usage: Top of the title placeholder (274 638 EMU).

tokens.name: space-content-top
tokens.usage: Where content starts under the title (≈1.33 in).

tokens.name: space-block
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked cards / rows (≈0.35 in).

tokens.name: space-tight
tokens.usage: Gap between a label and its note; icon-to-text.

tokens.name: band-top
tokens.usage: Top of the crimson title band on the title slide (1 487 532 EMU).

tokens.name: band-height
tokens.usage: Height of the crimson title band (1 548 172 EMU), full slide width.

tokens.name: logo-row-height
tokens.usage: Height of the ISA · SCORE · US logo row on title/closing slides.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Agenda frames, quote cards, spotlight frames, title band — the style is mostly square.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Layer cards and RQ cards (PowerPoint roundRect adj 5 846 ≈ 6 % of the short side).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Small RQ / tag pills.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Numbered agenda circles, stat bubbles, icon discs.

tokens.name: border-card
tokens.usage: 1.5 pt border of pastel layer cards.

tokens.name: border-frame
tokens.usage: 3 pt `signal-red` agenda frames and agenda circles; 2.25–3 pt spotlight frames.

tokens.name: border-arc
tokens.usage: 6 pt agenda arc.
